note: Adapted from the species description no. 216 in Chhotani (1997), Fauna of India: Isoptera. The original is in English; the alate is unknown and only the soldier is recorded. One maximum head width value is not given because of a gap in the OCR text. Nomenclatural and type-specimen data, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae pale; labrum, pronotum, legs and abdomen yellowish white; mandibles light reddish brown. Head with moderate pilosity, frontal projection with more hairs; pronotum more densely pilose, abdomen densely pilose; anterior margin of labrum with a pair of setae, labral body with two pairs of setae. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel (1.29 mm to base of mandibles); frontal projection broadly rounded and short; coronal suture short, only slightly visible near posterior margin. Fontanelle situated below the frontal projection. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3; segment 4 shortest. Anterolateral margins of labrum produced into sharp spines; anterior margin nearly straight. Mandibles asymmetrical; left mandible moderately twisted, apex forming a sharp, incurved hook; right mandible blade-like, apex narrow and pointed (left mandible 1.21 mm long, right mandible 1.17 mm long). Postmentum rod-like, waist weakly constricted near base (0.73 mm long, maximum width 0.32 mm, waist width 0.22 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin rounded, without notch (maximum width 0.48 mm).
